packageRules.description: walship is a library, so its Cargo.toml keeps version ranges, dev-dependencies included. An exact pin there stops cargo from picking one version that every crate in a build agrees on.

libsql, libsql-ffi and libsql-sys move together and only when a person asks. Each libsql-ffi minor is its own SQLite C library, and cargo refuses two in one build: walship on 0.10 can't be used by cell while cell's vendored libsql is on 0.9. Tick the box on the dependency dashboard once cell is ready.
